assumptions: W has finite support and accepted equivalence relation is defined
conclusion: Equivalence classes are finite and partition support
proof_summary: The accepted relation is closed reflexively, symmetrically, and transitively on a finite support set, so its classes form a finite partition.

conclusion: Each class has one quotient coordinate
proof_summary: A quotient coordinate is defined as a representative label for a nonempty class; because classes partition support, every coordinate maps to exactly one quotient coordinate.

assumptions: Quotient map is total and payload/certificate fields satisfy operation preconditions
proof_summary: Every indexed field is pushed forward along the total quotient map; conflicting merged fields are excluded by the congruence precondition and otherwise named as failure.

assumptions: At least one equivalence class has size greater than one
proof_summary: A finite partition with one nontrivial block has strictly fewer blocks than elements; the first support-measure coordinate support_size decreases.

conclusion: contraction is identity and not a smaller witness
proof_summary: If all classes are singleton, the quotient map is bijective and support_size is unchanged; this routes to the next operation rather than claiming reduction.

conclusion: contracted witness is in support normal form
proof_summary: Normalization should restore the selected support ordering and row conventions after quotient, but a dedicated normal-form preservation proof is still needed.

assumptions: payload congruence holds for every nontrivial class
proof_summary: Equivalent payload roles merge to one quotient component; this is proof-ready as a congruence argument but not completed for arbitrary recognized witnesses.

assumptions: status congruence or smaller-witness status theorem is available
conclusion: counterexample status is preserved or reduced
proof_summary: The current artifacts define the needed status relation and the status follow-up isolates equivalent-coordinate congruence, but they do not prove that quotienting active equivalent coordinates preserves the counterexample certificate.

conclusion: quotient then canonicalize agrees with canonicalize then quotient up to refinement
proof_summary: Canonical roles are part of the accepted equivalence, so the commutation proof is plausible, but it still depends on a canonical quotient sublemma.

conclusion: invalid or non-applicable contraction is named
proof_summary: A case split records invalid equivalence, singleton no-op, payload blocker, status blocker, canonical blocker, non-family-chain blocker, and later higher-support escape.

assumptions: current declared operation taxonomy is complete for this round
conclusion: no untracked contraction failure class remains inside selected target
proof_summary: The selected target has explicit rows for success, no-op, blockers, later operations, and escape; arbitrary support-growth completeness remains outside this operation proof.
